source_audit.interpretation: Exact co-occurrence is evidence, not a mandate. Use semantic role, visual motion, genre, and narration density together.

catalog_lookup.coverage: All 263 named sound effects placed across 1319 scanned draft_content.json files, including 114 authenticated encrypted drafts.
query_order: Filter sound_scene_catalog by the intended semantic scene.
Prefer a family whose motion and genre match the current visual.
Compare animation_counts and samples for exact evidence.
Resolve a path already present in the target draft package or copy an authorized local asset deliberately.
Apply repetition, density, narration, and silence rules before placement.

confidence.high: Multiple placements with consistent scene and animation evidence.
confidence.medium: One or more placements with coherent nearby dialogue or motion.
confidence.low: Specific foley with sparse or contradictory context; require an on-screen action or explicit semantic justification.

selection_order: Identify the semantic beat: hook, identity, conflict, proof, method, comparison, transition, CTA, or reflective ending.
Choose the text animation first; sound should explain the same motion or semantic change.
Build a candidate pool from the semantic role and motion. Do not let the first locally resolved asset become the default for unrelated beats.
Choose one sound family and the lowest intensity that remains audible under narration.
Check recent exact-asset and family usage before placement. Prefer a different justified family or silence over repeating the same cue.
Align the perceptual transient to the animation's visible start, not mechanically to the subtitle segment boundary.
Use silence for ordinary captions and recovery beats.
Resolve a real local or licensed audio asset before writing an audio material or segment.

draft_structure: Create a fresh materials.audios item with type=sound.
Place it through a fresh segment on a dedicated audio track.
Do not attach sound materials through text extra_material_refs.
Generate fresh runtime IDs for audio materials, segments, tracks, fades, and effects.

mixing.default_rule: For newly added talking-head sound effects, write volume=1.5 and last_nonzero_volume=1.5 unless the user requests another level or preview reveals clipping.
mixing.rule: Duck or omit the cue when it competes with a consonant, emotional pause, or important spoken number.

density.soft_documentary: one cue per 12-25 seconds or major semantic transition
density.standard_talking_head: one cue per 6-15 seconds, concentrated on hook, steps, proof, and CTA
density.high_packaging: one cue per 3-8 seconds with recovery beats
density.rule: Do not sonify every animated word.

repetition_control.motif_exception: Allow a second use only when the repeated sound intentionally marks the same recurring semantic event, not merely because the asset is available.
fallback_order: Choose another asset in the same family when the motion still requires that family.
Choose another semantically valid family with comparable intensity.
repetition_control.audit_rule: Before saving, group placed effects by resolved path and by family in rolling 30-second windows. Remove or replace any cue that exceeds these limits.

rules: Use whoosh_slide only for visible directional travel, wipe, comparison switch, or genuine chapter movement.
Do not use a whoosh for scale-only keywords, fades, static labels, proof numbers, or every text entrance.
Use ui_notification for small labels, steps, confirmations, or UI-like facts.
Use typing_texture for visible character reveal, AI text, definitions, messages, or search-like content.
Use impact for a decisive conclusion, contradiction, large number, or CTA peak.
Use premium_magic for a soft solution reveal or polished positive turn.
If no family explains the visible motion and semantic beat, use silence.

portability: Preserve placeholder paths only inside their original portable draft package.
For a new draft, resolve the placeholder to a real copied asset or use an intentional licensed replacement.
Validate every materials.audios path and audio segment material_id before delivery.
Do not copy source-project branding, tutorial labels, or copyrighted music as a sound effect.

whoosh_slide.timing: Start 0-120 ms before visible movement; let the transient land as the word reaches its final position.
avoid: using the same resolved whoosh asset more than once in a 30-second window unless it is a deliberate motif

ui_notification.timing: Put the click or chime on the first fully readable frame.

typing_texture.timing: Follow character reveal; trim immediately after the last visible character.

impact.timing: Align the main transient to maximum scale or the final settled word.
impact.intensity: medium; strong only for kinetic or variety profiles

premium_magic.timing: Place the sparkle after the first readable frame; preserve the tail only in visual breathing space.

paper_page.timing: Start with the page movement; text may begin 50-150 ms later.

use_when: entering a new chapter or place
camera_scene.timing: Use the transient on the cut or first new frame, not merely on text appearance.

money_value.timing: Align to the number becoming readable.

risk_break.timing: Put the transient on the contradiction word or visual break.

pop_cartoon.timing: Align to the bounce apex or settled state.

time_tick.timing: Use a short motif across the time comparison; stop before narration resumes.

suspense_texture.timing: Treat as a short texture or transition bed, not a punctuation hit.

bell_chime.timing: Land the bright transient on the first readable or settled frame; preserve a tail only when dialogue leaves room.

transition_reveal.timing: Start with the visible transition and land on the new scene or completed reveal.
avoid: using transition audio without a visible transition

comedy_variety.timing: Use on the reaction or punchline, not under setup dialogue.

avoid: sensitive violence topic without matching visual

retro_media.timing: Begin with the media motion and end or trim before current-time narration resumes.

technology_ui.timing: Place the transient on the state change or first stable interface frame.

emotion_human.timing: Follow the depicted human reaction; keep narration intelligible.

specific_foley.timing: Use the detailed catalog sample and synchronize to the physical or semantic action.
avoid: using sparse evidence without matching action
specific_foley.rule: Require an exact-name catalog lookup. Never choose this family from a broad semantic label alone.

reflective_ending.rule: Silence is often stronger than a final hit.

literal_action_or_scene.rule: Require a visible or explicit action and verify the exact asset in the detailed catalog.
